text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa wrote a letter to her 
former teacher. She likely hadn't become 
hope yet. She was also well aware of the 
public's evaluation of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—However, she swore she would give them 
hope.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, her mentor wrote a letter, 
following Nakayama Festa's lead. She 
explained there were things she couldn't 
say last time, because she really wanted 
to convey them in person—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan overcame her injury through 
the hope Nakayama Festa showed her. She 
vowed to deliver hope through their race 
against each other.
